interaction_cases.observed: Query C offered C1 through C8 and did not preselect a pitch.
B#3 resolved to MIDI 60/C4 while retaining B#3; Cb4 resolved to MIDI 59/B3 while retaining Cb4.

interaction_cases.case: Black-key side disambiguation and range limit
interaction_cases.observed: The black key beside G asked which side, lower led to F# octave choices, and D8 was reported outside A0-C8.

interaction_cases.case: Keyboard click, keyboard navigation, playback, and cancellation
interaction_cases.observed: Click selected A4/MIDI 69; ArrowRight focused A#4/Bb4 and Enter selected it; Play entered playing state and Stop cleared it.
88-key layout rendered 88 keys in 9 segments; 61-key layout rendered 61 keys in 6 segments with C2-C7 endpoints. Letter and octave toggles selected the matching PDF URLs.
C4-B4 section navigation updated hash/focus. Print at 61-key octave mode produced a hidden snapshot marked 61-key-C2-C7 with octave labels and no page error.
Selecting F#3 on staff selected MIDI 54 on keyboard and both staffs; flat mode displayed Gb3 for the same MIDI value.
Selecting MIDI 61 on the keyboard displayed Db4 and moved the staff selection to the same pitch.

interaction_cases.case: Clef, range, key-count, print-state, and audio state changes
interaction_cases.observed: Bass-only showed one staff; C2-C4 reset selection to C2 with 25 notes; 88-key mode produced 88 note controls and 15 print sheets; switching range while playing cancelled playback.
First/second inversion changes worked; Play chord entered playing state and Stop reported playback stopped; 1440 and 390 layouts had no document-level overflow.
